title: A swap hands the old session's tasks to the fresh session

requirements.text: After genlock swap, every open task the old session owned is logged as handed off, its claim released, and its owner cleared
swap.json's opening prompt names each handed task and tells the fresh session to take it with genlock start ID first
The fresh session's genlock start on a handed task succeeds and makes it the owner

evidence: node tests/run.mjs 517/0: last record on the task is op handoff with goal G; claims listed T before swap, not after; another session's task not in swap.json tickets. With the handoff disabled the checks FAIL (514/2)
node tests/run.mjs: swap.json prompt contains the task id and 'genlock start ID'; fails when handoff disabled
node tests/run.mjs: fresh-one 'start T' exits 0 and show T reads owner: fresh-one

answers.observed: 517/0 tests; disabling the handoff turns 2 checks red
answers.cause: swap never touched ticket owner or claims (read cmdSwap); fresh session only got genlock continue
answers.absence: Not run in the real app; the app bundle's genlock is the old build until rebuilt. Between swap and the fresh start the task shows unowned (free to pick up)
answers.assumption: Mine: drafts are not handed; blocked tasks are handed but the fresh session is told not to start them
answers.falsify: A real swap in the app where the fresh session's tab shows no task after it has run genlock start
